main_result.name: QFORM-CONDITIONAL-MINORITY-DISCRIMINANT-v1
main_result.statement_short: If Z in R^2 has density cap M, Y conditional on Z has a genuine density cap L, and Q=aY^2+2Yu^TZ+Z^TCZ+rY+s^TZ+c has coefficient matrix B with a det B>0, then ||p_Q||_inf <=2 L sqrt(pi M)(a det B)^(-1/4). Y and Z may be dependent.
main_result.mechanism: The scalar-root discriminant has definite planar quadratic matrix K=uu^T-aC with detK=a detB. Its eta-shell area is at most pi eta/sqrt(detK), so layer cake is finite. No indefinite joint-coarea shortcut is used.
main_result.near_coloop: For the true-near-coloop shared shift Y=X0+S/sqrt(c)+bU/(a sqrt(c)), the conditional density Y|(U,V) is <=1 because it is an average of translates of the untouched X0 density; the true planar projection cap is <=2. On a detLambda>0, ||p_Q||_inf <=2 sqrt(2pi)c^(-1/2)(|a|D)^(-1/4).
main_result.explicit_family: Balanced Walsh leaves and Lambda_*=[[-1/2,-sqrt(3)/2,0],[-sqrt(3)/2,1/2,0],[0,0,1]] have spectrum {-1,1,1} and density <6.009 for c>63/64.

combined_bound: On the minority-sign near-coloop branch combine with the previous pivot-free theorem: ||p_Q||_inf <=min(2 sqrt(2pi)c^(-1/2)(|a|D)^(-1/4),16.61(c delta D^2)^(-1/6)).
partner_application: Completed account02/B16 r37 at math-open-problems@c9c865f02890e5fe7108c49759ee82b84f42ee38: Q=2H(X1+Y1)+(X2+Y2)^2+2epsilon(X1+Y1)(X3+Y3)+X^TE_A X+Y^TE_B Y satisfies ||p_Q||_inf<=3|epsilon|^(-1/3), epsilon!=0, with C0 density. If max op norm(E_A,E_B)<=sqrt(2)-1, the full matrix retains at least three eigenvalues of modulus >=1; at epsilon=1 and norms<=1/4 the actual target inequality is <=3.
corrections_preserved: No independence after projection or rotation.
A bounded joint projection density is only used after the discriminant quadratic is definite; no indefinite level-set integral is bounded from the cap alone.
The conditional scalar cap in the near-coloop application is proved as an average of translates of an untouched original-coordinate density, not inferred from a marginal cap.
QFORM-CONDITIONAL-CAP-NOT-INDEPENDENCE-v1 remains active on the hyperbolic/zero-pivot interfaces.
No small coefficient on an unbounded source is deleted or treated perturbatively.
next_implication: QFORM-MAJORITYSIGN-ULTRACOLOOP-VECTOR-HILBERT-v1: handle the small nonzero hub pivot when a detLambda<0, retaining phase-weighted original-product cancellation through the hyperbolic discriminant; fixed shared-coordinate slices and cap-only indefinite shells are forbidden.
